name: Harbor Desk — urgent ticket alerts and daily digest

parameters.content:
## Urgent alerts
The API posts here whenever triage marks a ticket urgent or security-related. The filter is a second check: n8n never trusts that the caller only sends urgent events.

## Daily digest
Every weekday at 08:30 IST it reads the triage stats and posts one summary, so nobody has to open the console to know what arrived overnight.
